    """Fill every background cell between matching non-background neighbors with 2."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

            if grid[r][c] == background and grid[r][c - 1] != background and grid[r][c - 1] == grid[r][c + 1]:

def transform(grid):
    """Fill every background cell between matching non-background neighbors with 2."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h = len(grid)
    w = len(grid[0]) if h else 0
    background = max({v for row in grid for v in row}, key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(1, w - 1):
            if grid[r][c] == background and grid[r][c - 1] != background and grid[r][c - 1] == grid[r][c + 1]:
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
